verdict.rationale: Lambda documents a console, SSH and JupyterLab access, and a REST Cloud API, but nothing that lets users operate the product with natural-language commands. The only natural-language path in the pack is an unofficial, community-built CLI and MCP server. That is a third-party workaround, and the REST API is only a developer building block, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
